title: AI Passes Humanity's Last Exam and Generates Video Tutorials

contributions.purpose: 用推理时方法通过 Humanity's Last Exam
contributions.mechanism: Best-of-N(N=8, OptiLLM)拒绝采样 + 按题类选择专用模型
contributions.evaluation: HLE 53% 准确率(单模型最优仅 18%),人工核验随机 100 题
contributions.domain: LLM 评测 / 推理时扩展
contributions.source_quote: (i) Demonstrating AI passes the HLE by Best-of-N rejection sampling and selecting LLMs suitable for question categories

contributions.purpose: 分析准确率-时间-成本权衡
contributions.mechanism: 跨 17 模型/9 聚合方法对比 zero-shot 表现
contributions.evaluation: 最优配置 53%,均耗时 251.9 s/题,均成本 ~$3/题
contributions.source_quote: (ii) Analysis of trade-offs between zero-shot model accuracy, running time, and cost

contributions.purpose: 揭示模型间答案相似性
contributions.mechanism: 统计模型对之间相同(错误)答案比例并画相似性图
contributions.source_quote: (iii) Analysis of similarity and differences between models on HLE answers

contributions.purpose: 为数学题生成教学视频
contributions.mechanism: 用 LLM 生成 Manim 代码自动渲染讲解视频
contributions.evaluation: 发布教学视频库,每视频 ~30 分钟生成(定性)
contributions.source_quote: (iv) Generating a library of educational videos for understanding HLE math questions and answers

contributions.purpose: 梳理 AI 仍无法解决的难题及局限
contributions.mechanism: 数学专家精选 exact-match 难题并分析失败原因
contributions.evaluation: 精选一组 AI 未解 HLE 数学难题 + 局限/改进建议(定性)
contributions.source_quote: (v) Curation of a subset of hard HLE math questions with exact match answers by an expert Mathematician that AI cannot solve yet

self_declared_provenance.quote: We use Best-of-N rejection sampling with N=8, as implemented by OptiLLM [2] and extended to support different LLMs.

notes: over-claim:标题/摘要称 'AI Passes Humanity's Last Exam',实为闭源模型集成(o3-mini high + Sonnet 3.7 + Gemini 2 Flash)Best-of-N 得 53%,且仅人工核验随机 100 题。trade-off:成本 ~$3/题、251.9 s/题(高成本高延迟);自认无完美 verifier(imperfect verifier 产生 false positive)。贡献 5 条按论文自声明列表(i)–(v)。
